summary: The Planes of Existence are the cosmic realms that define reality. They are the domains of gods, primal forces, and metaphysical concepts. Each plane reflects the essence of its ruling deity or elemental foundation.

events: Creation of the Elemental Planes as the foundation of reality.
Birth of the Outer Planes as manifestations of divine will.
Formation of Time, Discord, and the Void as cosmic anomalies.
Gods establish dominion over their respective planes.
Planar boundaries stabilize, forming the Great Wheel.
First mortal incursions into Fear, Hate, and Sky.
The Plane of Time becomes accessible through temporal fractures.
